outcome: Concentrations of α-lactalbumin, lactoferrin, serum albumin, total caseins, immunoglobulins (IgA, IgM and IgG) and transforming growth factor (TGF) β1 and β2 in breast milk
finding: Breast milk content in major proteins of urban mothers in China was comparable with previous studies carried out in other parts of the world and C-section delivery had only very limited impact on breast milk immune factors.
mod_finding: C-section delivery had only a very limited impact on breast milk immune factors.
